query: SELECT cpp.clientEmail, cpp.setupToken, cpp.setupTokenExpiry, CASE WHEN cpp.passwordHash != '' AND cpp.passwordHash NOT LIKE '%placeholder%' THEN 'set' ELSE 'not set' END as passwordStatus FROM client_portal_passwords cpp WHERE cpp.clientEmail LIKE '%stylist%' OR cpp.clientEmail LIKE '%factory%' LIMIT 5;
